parameters.content:
## Scrape
Gets a brand's live ads from the Facebook Ad Library using Apify (search URL, brand and country are set in Config).
The search is sorted by impressions, so the first ads are the ones Meta shows the most.
Meta doesn't show spend or results for these ads, so this order is the best free signal we have.
All settings are in the Config node.

## Clean and score
Removes duplicates and broken text, and detects the language of each ad.
Each ad gets a performance score out of 100:
- 50% how high it ranks on impressions
- 35% how many days it has been running (capped at 90)
- 15% how many copies of the same ad are running
Only the top 8 different videos go to the AI.

## AI watches each ad
Downloads the video and sends it to Gemini, which watches and listens to it.
It returns the hook, body and CTA, plus a creative score out of 100.
The AI is not told the performance numbers, so its opinion stays separate.
If Gemini is busy it retries, then tries a backup model. If an ad still fails, it is marked and the run continues.

## Rank and report
Final score = 60% performance + 40% AI creative score.
Real performance counts more because Meta has already spent money on these ads.
Outputs an Excel sheet of all ads and a report (open the .html in Chrome and save as PDF).
